name: Sweep The Moon 🌕
desc:
😱 OH NO! The Moon is buried in space dust!
Sweep it clean, one tile at a time 🧹 

Inspired by Moon Sweepers on Steam.

🪥  Start with a toothbrush (yes, really)
🧹 Sweep the dust into your canister
💰 Empty it at the base for cash
⬆️ Upgrade your brush, canister and speed
🚜 Drive sweepers and giant rovers
🤖 Build robots, belts and machines
👥 Clean with up to 4 friends
🌕 Get the Moon to 100% clean!

👍 Like & Favorite if you had fun! 🔥

Tags: Sweep The Moon, Clean The Moon, Moon, Space, Sweep, Clean, Dust, Vacuum, Robots, Conveyor, Simulator, Incremental, Upgrade, Peel The Potato, Search For The Needle, Punch To Escape

llm.loop: sweep moon dust into canister -> empty at base for cash -> upgrade brush, canister, speed -> drive sweepers, build robots -> clean moon to 100%
llm.progression: tools from toothbrush to rovers, robots and conveyors, shards, classes
llm.instructions: sweep dust, empty canister, upgrade, drive sweepers, build robots, clean with friends
unique: Steam-game adaptation (Moon Sweepers) with map-wide completion goal
llm.thumbnails: cheems dog sweeping the moon with a toothbrush; rover sweepers
